name: Agent Governance
description: Windows MDM settings in the Agent Governance category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Access level
properties.description: Level of filesystem access granted for this directory. Subdirectories inherit the same access level unless they have their own rule.

properties.name: Agent Governance (Windows Insiders only)
properties.description:
Agent Governance policy for configuring AI agent containment settings.
 This setting is only available to Windows Insiders

properties.name: Allow agent execution in container
properties.description: Controls whether agent tools and loops can execute. The specific behavior depends on the selected agent.

properties.name: Allow network access
properties.description: Controls whether the contained agent is allowed to access the network. 0=blocked, 1=allowed.

properties.name: Allowed filesystem directories
properties.description: Specifies filesystem directories the contained agent can access. If no directories are configured, filesystem access is denied by default.

properties.name: Directory
properties.description: The filesystem directory path to which this access rule applies. Supports absolute paths and environment variables (e.g. D:\Repos, %USERPROFILE%).

properties.name: Identity profile
properties.description: The Entra user profile (UPN or SID) to run the agent as.

properties.name: Targeted agent
properties.description: The MSIX package family name of the targeted agent.
